GMT is the mean solar time at the Prime Meridian and serves as the global reference for time calculation.

items: Exam questions frequently test the location of GMT calculation: it is strictly measured at the Prime Meridian (0° Longitude).
Remember that GMT is fundamentally defined as 'mean solar time' for standard global reference.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: GMT stands for Greenwich Mean Time and is measured as mean solar time.
The Prime Meridian acts as the official geographic baseline for GMT.
GMT functions as the benchmark reference point for global time zone calculations.
